_note: Story 3 Hell-Dungeon on the hell runtime (src/hell/hell_game.gd, theme_path in src/hell/hell_dungeon.tscn). The hell look stays THEME_DEFAULT; this file only adds the hero systems the other worlds have (talents: the lasting talents and soul crystals, the same in every world, docs/LAUF-DESIGN.de.md). hero_from / hero_keys: these keys are taken from that theme file first, so classes, leveling, skills, relics, cards, sounds and music are shared with the Frostgruft and tuned in one place; keys written here override them. extra_sprites: textures the hero systems draw (relics, rock throws, the golem) loaded from dir when the world's own sprites lack them. No mobs key: the hell keeps its own monsters (src/hell/hell_monsters.gd). world_pack: the world kit builds every floor live from the run number (src/world_kit/world_core.gd + world_pack.gd, pack assets/data/hell_world.json from tools/hell_dungeon/hell_world.js); a new run rolls a new world, saves keep its number; the baked hell_floors.json is no longer read here. world_sizes: the HD manifest, so the pixel and HD sets build the same floor. vault_closed / vault_open: the giant vault chest before and after opening. plate_hint false: the plates do not show their order. mimic_kind: the monster a mimic chest wakes as (borrowed in hell_balance.json monsters.borrow); dormant_mimics: a mimic never shows as a monster. keys: the hell keys, the boss key now lies in the key room.

feel._note: The world's combat feel is the crypt's (src/vfx/feedback.gd through src/hero/story_feel.gd; materials in assets/data/vfx_gore.json; docs/VFX-SYSTEM.de.md). Here only the footsteps and growls: step_every = seconds between steps, idle_gap = seconds between growls, idle_range = px around the hero in which monsters growl.

glow._note: Bloom colours of the Hell-Dungeon (src/hero/story_glow.gd): portal = an awakened portal, wall = the walls' glowing slits and door posts, gate = gates that hold a fight. liquid = the lava banks: light_radius (world px) and light_strength (0..1) of their light in the dark, color and alpha (0..1) of their bloom (skill_fx.gd's lava glow, 0.32). The braziers keep the colour of their own light (hell_floors.json lights).
